{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Floor-length wrap gown, A-line, with a V-neckline and flutter sleeves, in dusty sage green (#9CAF88), in a flowing chiffon with a soft lining

Strappy block-heel sandals, open toe, 7 cm heel, in champagne gold (#D4B98A), in smooth satin

Small structured clutch, envelope shape, in soft ivory (#F2EBDD), in satin with a pearl clasp

Drop earrings, small teardrop shape, in pale gold (#E3CFA0), in polished metal with a pearl

Thin pearl bracelet, in ivory (#F4EEE2), on a delicate chain

Lightweight shawl, rectangular and draped over the arms for the evening, in warm blush (#E8CFC4), in sheer silk-blend voile

As a sister of the bride, you need an outfit that is formal and still lets you move through an outdoor ceremony in August and a restaurant dinner afterward. The sage green chiffon gown reads as dressy without competing with the bride, and it stays light and airy in the summer warmth. Block heels hold steady on grass and terrace paving, while the champagne tones in the shoes and jewelry pick up the glow of late afternoon light. The sheer shawl is only an optional wrap for the cooler evening at the restaurant, so you stay comfortable without adding a heavy layer."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2370,"output_tokens":459},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
